name: grokbot-discord-fleet
description: Discord fleet MCP (one discord-fleet server: status + manage tools, optional DISCORD_FLEET_READ_ONLY mode) + skills. Discord REST + optional self-hosted bridge /healthz. Each installer uses their own bot token — not shared provider infra. Not the wake bridge.

DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.title: Discord bot token
DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.description: YOUR Discord bot token for required Discord REST status/manage tools (Discord Developer Portal). Each marketplace installer supplies their own bot — not another installer's vault or a shared provider. Never commit.

DISCORD_GUILD_ID.title: Default Discord guild ID
DISCORD_GUILD_ID.description: Optional. Default guild snowflake for channel/guild status tools — your guild, not a shared one.

DISCORD_BRIDGE_HEALTH_URL.title: Bridge health URL
DISCORD_BRIDGE_HEALTH_URL.description: Optional. Full URL to YOUR self-hosted host bridge GET /healthz (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:18090/healthz). Omit if you are not running a bridge.

DISCORD_BRIDGE_CALLBACK_TOKEN.title: Bridge callback token
DISCORD_BRIDGE_CALLBACK_TOKEN.description: Optional. Bearer token for YOUR host bridge POST /discord/callback (same secret as the bridge Discord adapter callbackTokenRef). Used for agent self-callback / dual-deliver without a host vault hop. Never commit.

DISCORD_BRIDGE_CALLBACK_URL.title: Bridge callback URL
DISCORD_BRIDGE_CALLBACK_URL.description: Optional. Full callback URL for YOUR host bridge (placeholder example https://callback.example.com/discord/callback). Never ship real operator hosts.

DISCORD_FLEET_READ_ONLY.title: Read-only mode
DISCORD_FLEET_READ_ONLY.description: Optional. Set to 1 (or true/yes/on) to hide every Discord write/moderation tool (post, timeout, kick, ban, unban, delete, purge) from the discord-fleet MCP server. Unset, empty, 0, false, no or off = all tools. Any other value also turns read-only ON (fails closed, with a warning). Read tools stay available; write tools always need confirm=true.
